common.entity-ref.v1.title: EntityRef
common.entity-ref.v1.description: Typed reference to another service's entity. Store this instead of a foreign key; resolve a display projection from the owner.

common.no-body.v1.title: NoBody
common.no-body.v1.description: common.no-body@1: the capability's request carries no body; its parameters are the path and query of the routes in implementedBy (an id, a page cursor). An input schema that says so explicitly, so every active capability names one (roadmap WS-C task 4).

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

news.cluster-audit.v1.title: NewsClusterAudit
news.cluster-audit.v1.description: news.cluster-audit@1: one audited cluster change on OpenVibe.News (server/domain/clusters.js shapeAudit): a merge, a split or the reversal of one, with exactly which source items moved, who did it and why. Merge: cluster_id survived and other_id was absorbed; split: other_id is the new cluster.

actor.description: The editor (usr_…) or the service that acted.

reverses.description: The audit entry this one reverses.

reversed_by.description: The audit entry that reversed this one.

news.cluster-manage-request.v1.title: NewsClusterManageRequest
news.cluster-manage-request.v1.description: news.cluster-manage-request@1: bodies of news.cluster.manage on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/clusters/:id/merge { other, reason? } merges cluster other into :id (both open: 404 cluster.not_found, 409 cluster.not_open, 422 cluster.same). POST /api/v1/clusters/:id/split { items, reason? } moves those items into a new cluster (422 cluster.split_empty, cluster.split_foreign, cluster.split_all: at least one item stays). POST /api/v1/clusters/audit/:auditId/reverse { reason? } undoes a merge or split (404 cluster.audit_not_found, 409 cluster.already_reversed, 409 cluster.changed). Every change is audited with exactly which items moved.

items.description: Source item ids (nsi_…) of the cluster.

news.cluster-manage-result.v1.title: NewsClusterManageResult
news.cluster-manage-result.v1.description: news.cluster-manage-result@1: answers of news.cluster.manage on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/clusters/:id/merge → { cluster, audit } (the surviving cluster with items, audit and stories). POST /api/v1/clusters/:id/split → 201 { cluster, created, audit } (the source cluster and the new one with its items). POST /api/v1/clusters/audit/:auditId/reverse → { audit, clusters } (the reversal entry and the two clusters involved). Emits news.cluster.updated.

news.cluster-read-result.v1.title: NewsClusterReadResult
news.cluster-read-result.v1.description: news.cluster-read-result@1: answers of news.cluster.read on OpenVibe.News (editors, or a service holding news.cluster.read). GET /api/v1/clusters?limit= → { clusters } (open clusters, newest activity first). GET /api/v1/clusters/:id → { cluster } with its items, audit and stories (404 cluster.not_found). GET /api/v1/source-items/:id (nsi_… or itm_…) → { item } (404 source_item.not_found). GET /api/v1/ingest → { cursor, runs, sources }: the Sources cursor, the 50 latest ingestion runs and the cached source health.

state.description: ok | failed | ignored | an upstream state (http_error, timeout, …).

news.cluster.v1.title: NewsCluster
news.cluster.v1.description: news.cluster@1: one story cluster on OpenVibe.News (server/http/api.js clusterDto): a deterministic, explainable grouping of source items that report the same story, with its label (derived from the key terms, never invented), time window, key terms and entities. GET /api/v1/clusters/:id and merge/split answers add items, audit and stories.

created_by.description: svc:news (clustering) or the editor who split it off.

news.perspective-update-request.v1.title: NewsPerspectiveUpdateRequest
news.perspective-update-request.v1.description: news.perspective-update-request@1: bodies of news.perspective.update on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives { label, description? } adds an editor-labelled perspective (labels are written by editors, never generated; 422 perspective.no_label, 422 perspective.label_too_long over 80 characters; the description is cut to 500). PUT /api/v1/stories/:id/sources/:item/perspective { perspective } puts an attached source in a perspective (per_…) or in none (null or absent; 404 story.source_not_attached, 404 perspective.not_found). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives/:pid takes no body.

label.description: At most 80 characters once whitespace is collapsed.

news.perspective-update-result.v1.title: NewsPerspectiveUpdateResult
news.perspective-update-result.v1.description: news.perspective-update-result@1: answers of news.perspective.update on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives → 201 { perspective } (the stored row; timestamps in epoch milliseconds). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives/:pid → { removed: true } (its sources are left without a perspective). PUT /api/v1/stories/:id/sources/:item/perspective → { n, perspective_id }.

news.source-attach-request.v1.title: NewsSourceAttachRequest
news.source-attach-request.v1.description: news.source-attach-request@1: bodies of news.source.attach on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/sources { item } (or { item_id }) attaches a source item to the story's source table under the next number (a detached item gets its old number back); 404 source_item.not_found, 409 source_item.removed for an item removed upstream. DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/sources/:item takes no body and detaches it (its number is never reused; its timeline entries go with it; 404 story.source_not_attached).

item.description: A News source item id (nsi_…) or the OpenVibe.Sources item id it came from (itm_…).

item_id.description: A News source item id (nsi_…) or the OpenVibe.Sources item id it came from (itm_…).

news.source-attach-result.v1.title: NewsSourceAttachResult
news.source-attach-result.v1.description: news.source-attach-result@1: answers of news.source.attach on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/sources → 201 { n, created, item } (the source number; created false when it was already attached). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/sources/:item → { detached: true, n }.

news.source-item.v1.title: NewsSourceItem
news.source-item.v1.description: news.source-item@1: one source item as OpenVibe.News shows it to editors (server/http/api.js itemDto): the normalised OpenVibe.Sources item — headline, URL, outlet, authors, the date the source states and a licensed short summary, never a body — with its dedupe outcome, cluster and the stored explanation of its membership, and its upstream state.

sources_item.description: The OpenVibe.Sources item and the revision these fields came from.

published_at.description: As the source states it; null when it does not.

summary.description: A short summary, stored only when the source's terms allow it.

dedupe.description: { rule, detail } when the item is a duplicate.

cluster_reason.description: Why the item is in its cluster: { rule (shared_terms, new_cluster, duplicate_of, merged, split, …), shared_entities, shared_terms, score, … }.

removed.description: Set once the source removed the item upstream.

news.story-create-request.v1.title: NewsStoryCreateRequest
news.story-create-request.v1.description: news.story-create-request@1: the body of news.story.create on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/stories { headline, cluster?, topic?, slug?, body? | paragraphs? } opens a story (editors; a service acts for the editor in X-OV-Subject). The cluster's live, non-duplicate source items become its first sources, numbered by publication date; body or paragraphs (citing those numbers or item ids) becomes revision 1. Refusals: 422 story.no_headline (missing or over 200 characters), 404 cluster.not_found, 422 topic.not_found, 422 story.invalid_slug, 409 story.slug_taken, 422 story.claim_unsourced / story.unknown_source for a paragraph that cites nothing or a source not attached.

headline.description: The working headline; at most 200 characters once whitespace is collapsed.

cluster.description: The cluster (clu_…) to open the story from; merged clusters are followed.

topic.description: An active topic, by id (top_…) or slug.

body.description: Paragraphs separated by a blank line, each ending with the source numbers it rests on, e.g. "… said on Monday. [1, 3]".

text.description: At most 3000 characters once whitespace is collapsed.

anyOf.description: A source number [n] of the story's source table.
A News source item id (nsi_…) or the OpenVibe.Sources item id it came from (itm_…).

sources.description: The attached sources the paragraph rests on (at least one).

news.story-create-result.v1.title: NewsStoryCreateResult
news.story-create-result.v1.description: news.story-create-result@1: the answer of news.story.create on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/stories → 201 { story, revision } — the new draft story and the number of its first revision (null when no text was sent). Emits news.story.created.

news.story-publish-request.v1.title: NewsStoryPublishRequest
news.story-publish-request.v1.description: news.story-publish-request@1: bodies of news.story.publish on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/publish { revision?, correction? } publishes revision N (default the head) with an optional correction or update note readers will see. Refused while anything in the story's publishable list stands: 409 story.review_required (an AI revision no person approved), 409 story.source_removed / story.source_detached, 422 story.unsourced / story.claim_unsourced / story.no_headline (problems in the problem's extra); 422 story.correction_note_required when a source it cited was removed upstream and no note says what changed; 409 story.retracted; 404 revision.not_found. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/unpublish takes no body.

correction.description: A note given without kind is a correction.

news.story-publish-result.v1.title: NewsStoryPublishResult
news.story-publish-result.v1.description: news.story-publish-result@1: answers of news.story.publish on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/publish → { changed, resolved_flags, story } (changed false when that revision was already published and no note was given; resolved_flags are the upstream flags the revision answers). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/unpublish → { changed, story } (changed false when nothing was published). Emits news.story.published|updated|unpublished and the Search index events.

news.story-read-result.v1.title: NewsStoryReadResult
news.story-read-result.v1.description: news.story-read-result@1: answers of news.story.read on OpenVibe.News (editors, or a service holding news.story.read). GET /api/v1/stories/:id → { story, published } (the editor view with drafts, and the public model of the published revision or null; a caller without the capability gets only { published } of a published or retracted story, else 404 story.not_found). GET /api/v1/stories/:id/revisions?limit=&before= → { revisions } newest first. GET /api/v1/stories/:id/revisions/:n → { revision, citations, problems } (404 revision.not_found). GET /api/v1/stories/:id/diff?from=&to=&mode=line|word → { diff } of the text and a field-by-field comparison.

published.description: The public model of the published revision (the story page's .json twin); null while nothing is published.

sources_item.description: The OpenVibe.Sources item and the revision the story snapshotted.

sources.description: A source removed upstream shows only its number, outlet and the removal.

robots.description: index, follow | noindex, follow | noindex, nofollow

reasons.description: The publishing gate's reasons (code, effect, detail); empty when indexable.

authorship.description: The openvibe-publishing authorship record: mode, authors (usr_ ids), the OpenVibe.AI workflow { id, runId, version?, model? } of an ai or hybrid revision, stubProvider when a stub provider answered.

content.description: The paragraphs as text with their [n] markers.

fields.description: headline, paragraphs and the snapshotted source table, timeline and perspectives.

sources.description: The source table snapshot: n, id, sources_item_id, sources_revision, headline, url, outlet, authors, published_at, retrieved_at, summary, status, perspective.

authorship.description: The openvibe-publishing authorship record: mode, authors (usr_ ids), the OpenVibe.AI workflow { id, runId, version?, model? } of an ai or hybrid revision, stubProvider when a stub provider answered.

anchor.description: p<n> for a paragraph, t:<entry id> for a timeline entry.

problems.description: What stands between the revision and publication (story.unsourced, story.claim_unsourced, story.source_removed, story.source_detached, story.review_required, story.no_headline, …); empty when it can be published.

news.story-retract-request.v1.title: NewsStoryRetractRequest
news.story-retract-request.v1.description: news.story-retract-request@1: the body of news.story.retract on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/stories/:id/retract { note } retracts a published story with a public note (editors). The story stays at its URL with the notice, becomes noindex and leaves sitemaps and Search; final. Refusals: 422 story.retraction_note_required (under 10 characters once whitespace is collapsed), 422 flag.note_too_long (over 2000), 409 story.not_published.

news.story-retract-result.v1.title: NewsStoryRetractResult
news.story-retract-result.v1.description: news.story-retract-result@1: the answer of news.story.retract on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/stories/:id/retract → { changed, story } (changed false when the story was already retracted). Emits news.story.retracted and news.index_document.deleted.

news.story-revise-request.v1.title: NewsStoryReviseRequest
news.story-revise-request.v1.description: news.story-revise-request@1: bodies of news.story.revise on OpenVibe.News (editors; a service acts for the editor in X-OV-Subject). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/revisions { expected_revision, headline?, body? | paragraphs?, topic?, noindex?, message? } saves a new immutable revision snapshotting the source table, timeline and perspectives (expected_revision is required once a revision exists: 428 revision.expected_required, 412 revision.conflict on a stale one; every paragraph must cite an attached source: 422 story.claim_unsourced / story.unknown_source; 409 story.retracted). With X-OV-Origin: ai the revision is AI-generated and carries authorship { workflow: { id: news.summarize_story | news.compare_perspectives, run_id } } and gaps. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/ai-drafts { workflow? } asks OpenVibe.AI for a draft (default news.summarize_story; 503 ai.not_configured, 422 story.unsourced, 422 story.too_few_sources). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/flags { kind, note } adds a correction or update note published with the next publication.

expected_revision.description: The revision you edited (expectedRevision is read too).

headline.description: At most 200 characters; default the head's headline.

body.description: Paragraphs separated by a blank line, each ending with the source numbers it rests on, e.g. "… said on Monday. [1, 3]".

text.description: At most 3000 characters once whitespace is collapsed.

anyOf.description: A source number [n] of the story's source table.
A News source item id (nsi_…) or the OpenVibe.Sources item id it came from (itm_…).

sources.description: The attached sources the paragraph rests on (at least one).

topic.description: An active topic by id or slug; null or empty clears it.

noindex.description: true, 1 or "1" asks search engines not to index the story.

note.description: Public text readers will see; at most 2000 characters.

news.story-revise-result.v1.title: NewsStoryReviseResult
news.story-revise-result.v1.description: news.story-revise-result@1: answers of news.story.revise on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/revisions and POST /api/v1/stories/:id/ai-drafts → 201 { revision, created, story } (the revision number; created is false when the text and snapshot equal the head). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/flags → 201 { flag } (the stored flag row, open until the next publication; timestamps in epoch milliseconds).

news.story.v1.title: NewsStory
news.story.v1.description: news.story@1: one story as OpenVibe.News shows it to editors (server/http/api.js storyDto), drafts included: publication state, the head revision (headline and paragraphs that each cite source numbers, authorship), what stands between it and publication, the gate's indexability of the published revision, the working source table (numbered, never renumbered; detached sources stay listed), timeline, perspectives and editorial flags.

authorship.description: The openvibe-publishing authorship record: mode, authors (usr_ ids), the OpenVibe.AI workflow { id, runId, version?, model? } of an ai or hybrid revision, stubProvider when a stub provider answered.

system.description: Set on a revision News prepared after a cited source changed upstream: { reason, source_item_id, sources_item_id, sources_revision, based_on }.

gaps.description: What an AI draft could not support from the sources.

publishable.description: What stands between the revision and publication (story.unsourced, story.claim_unsourced, story.source_removed, story.source_detached, story.review_required, story.no_headline, …); empty when it can be published.

robots.description: index, follow | noindex, follow | noindex, nofollow

reasons.description: The publishing gate's reasons (code, effect, detail); empty when indexable.

news.timeline-update-request.v1.title: NewsTimelineUpdateRequest
news.timeline-update-request.v1.description: news.timeline-update-request@1: bodies of news.timeline.update on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/timeline { occurred_on, text, source } adds a dated entry resting on one attached source (occurredOn is read too): occurred_on is the date the source states (YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 time; 422 timeline.invalid_date), text at most 500 characters (422 timeline.no_text, timeline.too_long), source a source number or an attached item id (422 timeline.unknown_source, 409 source_item.removed). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/timeline/:eid takes no body (404 timeline.not_found).

source.description: The source number [n], or the attached item's id (nsi_… or itm_…).

news.timeline-update-result.v1.title: NewsTimelineUpdateResult
news.timeline-update-result.v1.description: news.timeline-update-result@1: answers of news.timeline.update on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/timeline → 201 { entry } (the stored row; timestamps in epoch milliseconds). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/timeline/:eid → { removed: true }.

news.topic-manage-request.v1.title: NewsTopicManageRequest
news.topic-manage-request.v1.description: news.topic-manage-request@1: the body of news.topic.manage on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/topics { name, slug?, description? } adds a canonical topic (editors; a service acts for the editor in X-OV-Subject). The name is collapsed and cut to 80 characters, the description to 300; the slug is made from slug or name (422 topic.no_name without a name, 422 topic.invalid_slug when it has no letters or digits).

news.topic-manage-result.v1.title: NewsTopicManageResult
news.topic-manage-result.v1.description: news.topic-manage-result@1: the answer of news.topic.manage on OpenVibe.News: POST /api/v1/topics → { topic, created } — 201 with the new topic, or 200 with the existing topic of that slug (created false; an existing topic is never renamed). Timestamps are epoch milliseconds.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
